Manage library

Stored JSON is grouped like a file browser. Root documents use .method, .baseline, or .practice. Expand a row to see nested practice elements with distinct pseudo-types (e.g. .focus, .alpha, .activity). Use the Add to library button to paste JSON or upload a .json file. You can import a single document or a JSON array of methods, baseline practices, and/or extension practices—each array element is stored as its own library item.
